summary: Comprehensive backend and frontend verification completed against the public URL. Acceptance flows pass: homepage numeric claims are removed; header/dropdown taxonomy is exact; Team Augmentation stats are correct; DT hero video is configured correctly; six static resource PDFs work; six published articles render; blog route redirects; CMS login/PDF upload/resource publish-display-delete succeeds; contact submits; and legacy routes render. Backend pytest: 16/17 passed. One taxonomy defect and two security/data-safety concerns were found.

critical.issue: Endpoint is unauthenticated and exposes all stored contact enquiries, including names, emails, phone numbers, companies and messages. Public request returned 200 and exposed the two QA enquiries.

Backend accepts removed or arbitrary taxonomy values. POST with type='blog' returned 200 and published the record; the test cleaned it up. This can reintroduce Blog through direct API use despite the exact three-type requirement.

minor.issue: Uploaded files have no delete/cleanup path. Deleting an insight leaves its PDF file record/object publicly retrievable, causing orphaned storage and persistent test uploads.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking a content trash button permanently deletes the item immediately without a confirmation dialog, creating an avoidable accidental data-loss risk.

action_items: Protect GET /api/contact with admin_guard (or remove the listing endpoint from the public API) and add a regression test for unauthenticated 401.
Constrain InsightCreate.type and InsightUpdate.type to Literal['article', 'case-study', 'resource']; similarly constrain status to draft/published. Re-run the taxonomy test.
Add file lifecycle cleanup or a protected delete endpoint so deleting/replacing CMS content can remove orphaned uploaded PDFs.
Add an AdminIA confirmation dialog before destructive insight deletion.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py models type and status as unrestricted strings; list_insights publishes every status except the literal 'draft', so arbitrary status values are also publicly visible.
server.py list_enquiries has no Depends(admin_guard), directly exposing stored PII.
AdminIA.remove() calls DELETE directly with no confirmation or undo.
Footer generated navigation Links do not consistently include data-testid attributes, although all interactive controls are expected to be test-addressable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested acceptance flows passed; one non-blocking destructive-action UX issue found

seed_data_creation: Created two TEST contact enquiries that persist because no contact delete API exists. Uploaded two TEST PDF objects that remain because no file deletion API exists. Temporary Resource and rejected-type Blog test insight records were deleted; final public insights state is 6 articles, 0 resources, 0 blogs.
test_credentials: CMS admin credentials were read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and verified successfully; secrets are not duplicated in this report.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py after adding API enums; the currently failing case is TestInsightsTaxonomy.test_backend_rejects_removed_blog_type. Also verify unauthenticated GET /api/contact becomes 401, admin-authenticated listing still works, file cleanup behavior, and AdminIA delete confirmation. All requested public/CMS E2E acceptance criteria otherwise passed on the public URL. The first public Playwright run stopped only because its legacy ProductPage test selector was incorrect; the corrected selector product-page-hrms passed in the follow-up run and is not an app defect.
rca_of_the_issue: Taxonomy RCA: InsightCreate/InsightUpdate declare type: str and status: str, so Pydantic performs no enum validation; create_insight persists values unchanged. Contact exposure RCA: list_enquiries is registered without Depends(admin_guard). Orphan-file RCA: files are stored independently in db.files/object storage, while insight deletion only deletes the insights document. Admin delete RCA: remove(slug) directly invokes axios.delete without a confirmation state/dialog.
